Z1.title: Two-board network
Z1.heading: A coordinator and an end device
Z1.goal: Flash one Pulsar C5 as a Zigbee coordinator and another as an end device. The end device counts once a second and reports the count; the coordinator prints what arrives.
steps: Flash the coordinator with the command above. It opens the network for three minutes.
Flash the second board: arduino-cli compile -u -p PORT2 --fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32c5:CDCOnBoot=cdc,PSRAM=enabled,FlashSize=8M,PartitionScheme=zigbee_8MB,ZigbeeMode=ed sketches/pulsar-c5/z1-end-device.
Watch the coordinator: End device bound, then the counts.
Press BOOT on the coordinator to ask for a report on every change; on the end device, a short press reports at once and a 3-second hold resets its network settings.
Z1.note: The count rides in the Temperature Measurement cluster, a trick from Espressif's examples. The C6 course's Labs 7 and 8 (PULSAR Stick, PULSAR Powersupply) ship ready-made C6 firmware and are not ported.
